label: confirmation

leaf_residual.note: Positive means the 2-leaf residual exceeds the 256-leaf residual.

leaf_clean_risk.note: Positive means clean risk is higher at 256 leaves than at 2.

forest_clean_risk.note: Positive means one restricted tree has higher clean risk than 50 trees.

nonidentifiability: A replicated linear noise contrast and a replicated leaf-versus-forest contrast do not identify one shared mechanism. The MLP budget reversal remains an alternative that this stage does not re-estimate.
not_reestimated: The R3 result that 40 epochs had lower clean risk than until_residual is not fit again.
The gradient-boosting depth curve is not fit again and is not treated as an interpolation bracket.
